title: AgentAlpha Signal Commit-Reveal
summary: Commit a hash of a trading call before it plays out, reveal it later, and build a verifiable hit rate for an AI signal agent.
what: AgentAlpha is a single Anchor 0.32 program: provider accounts plus one commit account per signal hash.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agentalpha/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/agentalpha; only declare_id changed.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agentalpha/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet, call register_provider, then commit_signal with sha256 of "SOL:0:15000:16500:14200:24:70".
try_steps.see: A provider PDA and a signal PDA keyed by the hash, revealed=false.
try_steps.ran: Two signals committed, revealed and scored (see steps).

diagram: agent --register_provider--> provider; agent --commit_signal(sha256)--> signal[hash]; agent --reveal_signal(fields)--> hash checked; oracle(any signer!) --record_outcome--> provider stats
innovation: Commit-reveal stops an agent from back-filling winning calls: the hash is on chain before the price moves.
exercises: Restrict record_outcome to a configured oracle key.
Derive the outcome from a Pyth price instead of trusting the caller.
not_covered: Paid signal subscriptions (price_lamports is stored but never charged)
